oneLiner: 光过双缝形成干涉条纹，证明光的波动性。
oneLinerEn: Light through two slits makes interference fringes, proving waves.
detail: 1801 年，托马斯·杨在英国皇家学会宣读论文，让光先过一条窄缝、再落到紧邻的两条窄缝上，屏幕上出现的不是一亮带而是明暗相间的条纹。两条缝相当于两个相干光源：波峰与波峰相遇处加强变亮、波峰与波谷相遇处抵消变暗，这正是「波的叠加与干涉」。相邻明纹间距正比于波长、正比于缝屏距离、反比于双缝间隔，即 Δy=λL/d——于是用一把尺子量出条纹间距，就能反推出光的波长，杨由此估得可见光波长在数百纳米量级。这一结果为光的波动说提供了决定性证据，压过了当时由「艾萨克·牛顿」权威撑腰、占主流地位的微粒说，也直接催生了「干涉与衍射」这一整条研究路线。更奇妙的是两百多年后的单粒子版本：把光源弱到一次只发射一个光子、让它在屏上逐点累积，起初满是杂乱无章的落点，时间一长干涉条纹却从统计中缓缓浮现——单个光子仿佛同时穿过两条缝、与自己发生干涉。一旦在缝口架设探测器去“看”它究竟走了哪条缝，条纹立刻消失、退化成两道亮带。杨氏双缝因此成为量子力学「波粒二象性」最纯粹、也最令人不安的演示，费曼甚至断言它“包含了量子力学的唯一奥秘”。1961 年起，电子、中子乃至由上百个原子组成的分子都被逐一拿来做双缝实验，条纹无一例外地出现——波动性并非光独有的脾气，而是物质的底色。
detailEn: In 1801 Thomas Young read a paper to the Royal Society in which light first passed through one narrow slit and then fell on two closely spaced slits; the screen showed not a single bright band but alternating bright and dark fringes. The two slits act as coherent sources: crest meeting crest reinforces into a bright band, crest meeting trough cancels into a dark one — exactly the superposition and interference of waves. The spacing between adjacent bright fringes is proportional to the wavelength and to the slit-to-screen distance and inversely proportional to the slit separation, Δy=λL/d; so measuring the fringe spacing with a ruler lets one infer the wavelength of light, and Young estimated visible wavelengths in the hundreds of nanometres. This gave decisive evidence for the wave theory of light, over the then-dominant corpuscular view backed by Newton's authority, and launched the whole programme of interference and diffraction. Stranger still is the single-particle version made two centuries later: dim the source until it emits one photon at a time and let the dots pile up slowly on the screen — at first a scatter of random hits, then, over time, the interference pattern emerges out of the statistics, as though each photon passed both slits and interfered with itself. Put a detector at the slits to see which one it went through, and the fringes vanish at once, collapsing to two plain bands. The double slit thus became the purest and most unsettling demonstration of wave-particle duality in quantum mechanics, and Feynman went so far as to say it 'contains the only mystery' of the theory. From 1961 on, electrons, neutrons and even molecules of a hundred-plus atoms have each been run through a double slit, and fringes appear in every case — wave behaviour is not a habit unique to light but the underlying colour of matter itself.

oneLiner: 探测“以太风”得零结果，为相对论扫清障碍。
oneLinerEn: Sought the aether wind but found none, clearing the way for relativity.
detail: 19 世纪物理学家普遍认为光波必须靠一种充满宇宙的介质传播，称之为“以太”；地球以约每秒钟三十公里的速度绕日运行，理应迎头撞上一阵“以太风”。1887 年迈克尔逊与莫雷在美国克利夫兰用改进的干涉仪检验此事：把一束光分成互相垂直的两路、各经反射镜折回再合拢，若两路所受“以太风”影响不同，光程就会产生微小差异，转动仪器九十度时干涉条纹应当平移。按地球轨道速度与光速之比估算，预期的条纹移动约零点四条纹宽，可是不管何时、朝哪个方向反复测量，条纹几乎纹丝不动——实测值不到预期的百分之一，这就是著名的“零结果”，后世称之为“历史上最著名的失败实验”。它干脆否定了静止以太的存在，动摇了绝对时空的根基，为 1905 年爱因斯坦把「狭义相对论基本原理」的两条公设——物理定律在一切「惯性系」中相同、真空「光速」对谁都不变——当作出发点扫清了道路。为挽救以太，洛伦兹与斐兹杰惹曾独立假设物体沿运动方向会收缩、恰好抵消光程差；这一“收缩假说”后来被相对论自然地吸收为「长度收缩」。实验并未就此落幕：肯尼迪与索恩代克在 1964 年延长一臂重做，近代又以互相垂直的稳定激光腔比对不同方向的谐振频率，把可能的各向异性压到 10⁻¹⁷ 量级——一百多年过去，“以太风”依旧毫无踪影，光速不变依然是被反复验证的事实。
detailEn: Nineteenth-century physicists held that light waves must ride on a medium filling the universe, the 'aether'; since Earth sweeps around the Sun at some thirty kilometres a second, it should run into an 'aether wind'. In 1887 Michelson and Morley, in Cleveland, tested this with a refined interferometer: split a beam into two perpendicular arms, reflect each back and recombine; if the aether wind affected the two paths unequally, a tiny light-path difference would appear, so turning the instrument by ninety degrees should shift the interference fringes. Judging from the ratio of Earth's orbital speed to the speed of light, the expected shift was about four-tenths of a fringe, yet no matter when or in which direction they repeated it, the fringes barely moved — the measured value was under one per cent of the prediction. This was the famous 'null result', later called the most famous failed experiment in history. It flatly ruled out a stationary aether and shook the foundations of absolute space and time, clearing the road for Einstein in 1905 to take as his starting point the two postulates of special relativity — the laws of physics are the same in every inertial frame, and the speed of light in vacuum is the same for everyone. To save the aether, Lorentz and FitzGerald had independently proposed that bodies contract along the direction of motion by just enough to cancel the light-path difference; that contraction hypothesis was later absorbed naturally by relativity as length contraction. The experiment did not end there: Kennedy and Thorndike repeated it in 1964 with one arm lengthened, and modern work compares the resonance frequencies of perpendicular stabilised laser cavities, pinning any possible anisotropy to the 10⁻¹⁷ level. After more than a century the aether wind is still nowhere to be found, and the constancy of light speed remains a repeatedly verified fact.

oneLiner: 悬浮带电油滴测出元电荷，证实电荷量子化。
oneLinerEn: Measured the elementary charge, confirming quantization.
detail: 1909 至 1913 年，密立根在芝加哥让极小的带电油滴在两枚水平平行极板之间缓缓下落。他用喷雾器喷出油珠，油滴在喷出时因摩擦而带电，再用 X 射线照射、把电荷打得改变，从而观察同一颗油滴在不同带电量下的运动。不加电场时，油滴受重力与空气阻力（斯托克斯定律）作用，很快达到一个匀速的收尾速度；加上竖直电场，则可把油滴悬停、或令其匀速上升。由匀速时受力平衡，他先算出油滴的质量与半径，再算出每颗油滴所带电量——惊讶地发现所有读数都是同一个最小值的整数倍，而这个最小值正是「元电荷」e，他测得约 1.60×10⁻¹⁹ 库仑（现代值 1.602×10⁻¹⁹）。第一次以干净直接的方式证明电荷不是连续的水流，而是一份一份量子化的。为消除微小油滴上空气阻力偏差，他还引入了对空气平均自由程的修正，把结果校准到与今日值仅差不到百分之一。这桩测量与「阴极射线实验：电子的发现」正好互补：汤姆孙 1897 年测的是电子的比荷 e/m，密立根测的是 e，两值相除才得到「电子质量」；正是这套“电荷量子化＋电子”的图景，让密立根独得 1923 年诺贝尔物理学奖。围绕他是否挑选了对己有利的数据、把偏离整数倍的读点悄悄剔除，后世科学史家争论了近百年——但电荷是一份一份的这一结论，从原子核的质子数到今天的单电子梭形器件，早已成为整个物理与电工计量大厦的地基。
detailEn: Between 1909 and 1913 Millikan, at Chicago, watched tiny charged oil droplets fall slowly between two horizontal parallel plates. He sprayed oil from an atomiser, so the droplets took on charge by friction, then irradiated them with X-rays to change that charge and follow the same droplet under different electrifications. With no field a droplet feels gravity and air drag (Stokes' law) and quickly settles to a steady terminal speed; with a vertical field it can be held suspended or made to rise at a constant rate. From the force balance when moving uniformly he first worked out the droplet's mass and radius, then its charge — and found, strikingly, that every reading was a whole-number multiple of one smallest value, the elementary charge e, which he measured at about 1.60x10^-19 coulomb (modern value 1.602x10^-19). It was the first clean, direct proof that charge is not a continuous fluid but quantized in packets. To correct the drag on such small droplets he added a correction for air's mean free path, bringing his result within under one per cent of today's value. This measurement pairs exactly with the cathode-ray discovery of the electron: Thomson in 1897 had found the charge-to-mass ratio e/m, Millikan found e, and dividing the two yields the electron mass; it was this picture — quantized charge plus the electron — that won Millikan the 1923 Nobel Prize in Physics. Whether he cherry-picked data favourable to his conclusion, quietly dropping readings that strayed from a whole multiple, has been debated by historians of science for nearly a century. But the verdict that charge comes in packets has since become the bedrock of the whole edifice of physics and electrical metrology, from nuclear proton number down to today's single-electron shuttle devices.

oneLiner: α 粒子大角度散射，提出原子核式模型。
oneLinerEn: Large-angle α scattering led to the nuclear model.
detail: 1909 年，在曼彻斯特，盖革与年仅约二十岁、还是本科生的马斯登，在卢瑟福指导下用放射源放出的 α 粒子轰击极薄的金箔——金箔厚度只有一千来个原子，四周环置涂硫化锌的荧光屏，靠显微镜逐点数闪烁。按当时汤姆孙的“葡萄干布丁”模型，正电荷像布丁一样均匀铺满整颗原子、电子嵌在其中，质量也散布各处，那么又重又快、带正电的 α 粒子穿过去时应当几乎一路直穿、只极小角度偏折。结果令人震惊：绝大多数确实径直穿过，说明原子内部非常空旷；但大约每八千颗里就有一颗被大角度弹开，个别甚至偏过九十度原路返回。卢瑟福后来说这“就像你用十五英寸炮弹轰一张纸巾，炮弹却被弹回来打中了你”。1911 年他据此提出「原子的核式模型」：原子的几乎全部质量与全部正电荷，都集中在一个直径仅约原子万分之一（10⁻¹⁴ 米对 10⁻¹⁰ 米）的微小核里，电子在核外广阔空间绕行——原子行星模型由此诞生，他还用库仑散射公式算出了核的电荷。可这套图像立刻撞上经典电磁学的难题：按麦克斯韦理论，绕核旋转的电子本该不断辐射能量、在极短时间内螺旋坠入核内，原子应当瞬间塌缩。正是这个矛盾，逼出了玻尔次年把量子化条件塞进轨道、用「能级与氢原子光谱」为原子续命，最终由「波粒二象性」与量子力学彻底解决。
detailEn: In 1909, in Manchester, Geiger and Marsden — the latter barely twenty and still an undergraduate — bombarded an extremely thin gold foil, only some thousand atoms thick, with alpha particles from a radioactive source under Rutherford's direction, ringed with zinc-sulfide screens and counting the scintillations one by one through a microscope. On Thomson's then-current 'plum pudding' model, positive charge smeared through the whole atom like batter with electrons set into it and the mass spread out too, a heavy, fast, positively charged alpha particle should pass almost straight through with only tiny deflections. The result was astonishing: most indeed went clean through, showing the atom is mostly empty; but roughly one in eight thousand was hurled through a large angle, a few past ninety degrees, straight back. Rutherford later said it was 'as if you fired a fifteen-inch shell at a piece of tissue paper and it came back and hit you'. In 1911 he proposed the nuclear model of the atom: nearly all its mass and all its positive charge sit in a minute nucleus about ten-thousandths the diameter of the atom (10^-14 metres against 10^-10), with electrons circling in the vast space outside — the planetary atom was born, and he derived the nuclear charge from his Coulomb scattering formula. But the picture at once ran into the wall of classical electromagnetism: on Maxwell's theory an electron orbiting the nucleus should radie energy continuously and spiral inward in a flash, so the atom should instantly collapse. It was exactly this puzzle that drove Bohr the next year to force quantisation onto the orbits and keep the atom alive through the energy levels and hydrogen spectrum, a conflict finally resolved only by wave-particle duality and quantum mechanics.

oneLiner: 首次测出引力常数 G，并估算地球质量。
oneLinerEn: First measured G and estimated Earth's mass.
detail: 1797 至 1798 年，卡文迪许在自家实验室搭起一台极其灵敏的扭秤，只为测出那肉眼永远看不见的引力到底有多大。装置是一根约三十厘米长的水平木杆，两端各固定一个铅球，用一根细丝从中悬吊；杆外另置两个可绕轴转动的巨大铅球。大球靠近时，它与小球之间那点微弱的「万有引力定律」之力会轻轻扭动悬丝，把杆转过一个几乎无法察觉的角度——卡文迪许在悬丝上贴一小片镜，把一束光反射到远处的刻度尺上，用光点的移动把这微小转角放大读出，从而测出引力的大小与悬丝的扭转常数。由这个力他算出地球的平均密度约为水的 5.5 倍（约每立方厘米 5.5 克），据此即可推出地球质量约 6×10²⁴ 千克——这就是“称出地球”的由来，他本人却谦逊地只说“测了地球密度”。有意思的是，他至死都没给出「引力常数」G 的数值；G≈6.67×10⁻¹¹ 牛·米²/千克² 是后人在一百年后（如 1891 年玻伊兹用更精细的石英丝扭秤）由他的数据换算而来。为排除人体与空气流动带来的极微气流干扰，他把整套仪器关在屋内、只从屋外通过望远镜读取光点——这种“隔室观测”正是微小量测量思想的早期典范。用扭镜放大微小形变与转角的路数，后来被库仑测静电力、被迈克尔逊那一类精密光学实验、乃至今天探测「引力波」的激光干涉仪一路继承。
detailEn: In 1797-1798 Cavendish set up in his home laboratory a strikingly sensitive torsion balance, aiming only to measure how strong that invisible force of gravity really is. The device was a horizontal wooden rod about thirty centimetres long with a lead ball fixed at each end, hung from its middle by a thin fibre; outside the rod sat two huge lead balls that could be turned on an axis. As a large ball drew near, the feeble pull of universal gravitation between it and the small ball twisted the fibre through an angle almost too small to perceive — Cavendish stuck a tiny mirror on the fibre and reflected a beam of light onto a distant scale, magnifying that slight turn into a moving spot he could read, and so measured both the force and the fibre's torsion constant. From it he found Earth's mean density about 5.5 times that of water (roughly 5.5 grams per cubic centimetre), which yields an Earth mass of about 6x10^24 kilograms — the origin of 'weighing the Earth', though he modestly said only that he had 'weighed the density of the Earth'. Curiously, he never himself gave a number for the gravitational constant G; the value G about 6.67x10^-11 newton metre-squared per kilogram-squared was converted from his data a century later, for instance by Boys in 1891 with a finer quartz-fibre balance. To shut out the faint air currents from his own body and the room, he sealed the whole apparatus indoors and read the light spot through a telescope from outside — this 'observation through a wall' is an early model of the craft of measuring minute quantities. The strategy of amplifying a tiny twist with a torsion mirror and light lever was inherited directly by Coulomb for the electrostatic force and, down the line, by the laser interferometers that detect gravitational waves today.

oneLiner: 光照射金属打出电子，爱因斯坦用量子解释，佐证光子说。
oneLinerEn: Light ejects electrons; Einstein's quantum explanation supported photons.
detail: 光照射到金属表面会把电子打出来，称作光电子，这现象最早由赫兹在 1887 年做「赫兹电磁波实验」时偶然注意到：接收间隙在紫外光照射下更容易蹦出火花。随后勒纳德系统研究，摆出几条经典波动说怎么都解释不通的事实：能不能打出电子，只看光的频率有没有越过某个“截止频率”，与光的强弱无关；一旦越过阈值，发射几乎瞬时发生、延迟不超十亿分之一秒；增大光强只会增多电子数目，而唯有提高频率，才抬高每个电子的最大动能——按波动图像，能量该随光的亮度累积、与颜色无关，理应越亮越“猛”，现实却恰恰相反。1905 年爱因斯坦用「光子」假说一举破解：光的能量本就不连续，而是一份份传播，每份 E=hν；一个光子把全部能量一次交给一个电子，扣掉电子挣脱金属所需的“逸出功”W，剩下的便是最大动能，即 Eₖ=hν−W。于是截止频率对应 hν₀=W，光强只管光子数目、频率才决定每个光子能量。密立根本想用精密实验证伪这条方程，测到 1916 年却越测越服、把普朗克常数 h 校到约百分之二，反因此印证了它；这也解释了为何“光电”与碱金属（铯对可见光敏感、锌须紫外）的选材。这桩工作坐实了光的粒子性、为「波粒二象性」补上关键一环，让爱因斯坦独得 1921 年诺贝尔物理学奖；而它的下游，从光电管、光电倍增管、太阳能电池到数码相机的感光芯片，全都建立在“一个光子打出一个电子”这条规则之上。
detailEn: Light falling on a metal knocks out electrons, called photoelectrons — a fact Hertz first stumbled on in 1887 during his electromagnetic-wave experiments, when a receiving spark gap sparked more easily under ultraviolet light. Lenard then studied it systematically and laid out several facts classical wave theory could not explain: whether electrons come off at all depends only on whether the light's frequency clears a certain 'threshold frequency', not on its intensity; once past threshold emission is essentially instant, with a delay under a nanosecond; more intensity only sends out more electrons, while only raising the frequency lifts each electron's maximum kinetic energy. On the wave picture, energy should build up with brightness regardless of colour, so brighter light ought to be 'fiercer' — yet reality was the opposite. In 1905 Einstein solved it at a stroke with the photon hypothesis: light's energy is not continuous but travels in packets, each E=hν; one photon hands its whole energy to one electron at once, and what is left after paying the 'work function' W needed to escape the metal becomes the maximum kinetic energy, E_k = hν − W. So the threshold frequency obeys hν₀ = W, intensity governs only the number of photons, and frequency sets each photon's energy. Millikan set out to refute the equation by precision experiment, and by 1916 had made it more convinced the better it agreed, pinning Planck's constant h to about two per cent; this also explains the choice of material — caesium responds to visible light, zinc needs the ultraviolet. The work nailed down the particle side of light, supplied a key link in wave-particle duality, and earned Einstein the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics; its descendants, from phototubes and photomultipliers to solar cells and the sensor chips of digital cameras, all rest on the single rule that one photon frees one electron.

oneLiner: 用斜面“冲淡重力”研究匀加速运动，奠定实验物理。
oneLinerEn: Diluted gravity with ramps to study uniform acceleration, founding experimental physics.
detail: 自由落体下落太快，在伽利略的年代根本没有能精确计时的工具。于是他约在 1604 年起让铜球沿一道磨得很光滑、阻力极小的斜面缓缓滚下，用“冲淡重力”的办法把加速度稀释成正比的 sinθ 倍、把运动放慢以便测量。他靠一座水钟计量时间——放出水流称重来量出历时——反复测下发现：球从静止滚过的路程，与所用时间的平方成正比，即 s∝t²，这正是速度均匀增加的「匀变速直线运动」的铁证。他还发现：同一倾角下，无论铜球轻重，加速度都相同，一举推翻了亚里士多德“越重的物体落得越快”延续近两千年的断言；把倾角一路推到竖直，他外推出自由落体也服从同样的规律（至于比萨斜塔同时抛两球的故事，多半是后人附会的传说）。再配上“理想实验”：小球沿一斜面滚下、会沿对面斜面滚到几乎同样的高度，若把对面斜面越放越平，球就为达到那高度而越滚越远——由此萌生了「牛顿第一定律（惯性）」的雏形：“若无阻力，运动物体将永远运动下去”。把可控实验、精密计时与几何推理拧成一体，用斜面“稀释”掉测不了的现象，正是伽利略为近代科学方法立下的开山范式，爱因斯坦因此称他为“近代科学之父”。
detailEn: Free fall is too swift to time with the tools of Galileo's day, so from about 1604 he let a bronze ball roll slowly down a well-polished, low-friction inclined plane, 'diluting gravity' to scale the acceleration down by the sine of the slope and slow the motion enough to measure. He kept time with a water clock — weighing the water that ran off to read the elapsed interval — and found, run after run, that the distance the ball rolled from rest grew as the square of the time, s proportional to t-squared: the iron signature of uniformly accelerated motion. He further showed that on a given slope the acceleration is the same whatever the ball's weight, overturning Aristotle's claim, held for near two thousand years, that heavier bodies fall faster; and by pushing the slope all the way to vertical he extrapolated that free fall obeys the very same law (the story of the Leaning Tower of Pisa is most likely a later legend). Pairing this with a 'thought experiment' — a ball rolling down one ramp climbs the opposite ramp to nearly the same height, and the flatter the opposite ramp is made, the farther it rolls to reach that height — came the seed of Newton's first law of inertia: with no resistance, a moving body keeps moving. To weld controlled experiment, precise timing and geometric reasoning into one, and to 'dilute' an unmeasurable phenomenon with a ramp, is exactly the founding paradigm Galileo set for the modern scientific method — which is why Einstein called him 'the father of modern science'.

oneLiner: 用振荡电路发射并接收电磁波，证实麦克斯韦预言。
oneLinerEn: Generated and detected EM waves, confirming Maxwell.
detail: 1860 年代，「詹姆斯·麦克斯韦」从他的方程组预言：变化的电场与磁场会彼此激发、以横波的形式在空间中传播，速度恰等于「光速」，因此光本身就是一种电磁波。这当时只是一串漂亮的数学，直到 1887 至 1888 年在卡尔斯鲁厄，赫兹用实验把它坐实。他用一台鲁姆科夫感应线圈驱动一对隔着空气间隙的锌板作发射器，在几米外放一个留有微小开口的铜环作接收器——接收间隙间果然蹦出肉眼几乎看不见的微小火花，说明电磁波真的被发射出去、又在远处被收到了。赫兹进一步在导线对上测出驻波，从相邻波节间距拿到波长、乘上振荡电路的频率，算得的传播速度约等于光速；他又用锌板做出反射、用沥青棱柱做出折射、用一排金属丝做出偏振，逐项证明它与光同属一种「电磁感应」框架下的横波，甚至连“光是电磁波”这一断言都被一并验证。有趣的是，赫兹本人对这一划时代发现的应用前景相当冷淡，据说他断言这些波“毫无用处”。然而正是这桩实验开启了无线电通信的时代：马可尼与特斯拉后来把电磁波送上天空、催生了广播、雷达、电视与今天的手机。为纪念他，频率的单位被命名为“赫兹”；而德国物理学家以他名字命名、却在他英年早逝（1894 年去世，年仅 36 岁）之后，才让「赫兹电磁波实验」成为一个永被引用的名词。
detailEn: In the 1860s James Clerk Maxwell, from his equations, predicted that changing electric and magnetic fields would sustain one another and travel through space as a transverse wave moving at exactly the speed of light, so that light itself is an electromagnetic wave. For a long time this was only a beautiful piece of mathematics, until in Karlsruhe in 1887-1888 Hertz turned it into experiment. He drove a pair of zinc plates separated by an air gap with a Ruhmkorff induction coil as a transmitter, and set a copper ring with a tiny opening several metres away as a receiver — and a spark too faint for the eye to catch really leapt the gap, showing that electromagnetic waves were being sent out and caught at a distance. Hertz then measured standing waves along a wire pair, read the wavelength from the spacing of adjacent nodes, multiplied by the oscillation frequency of the circuit, and got a propagation speed close to that of light; he demonstrated reflection off a zinc sheet, refraction through a pitch prism, and polarisation through a grid of wires, proving item by item that they are transverse waves of the same kind as light within the framework of electromagnetism — even the claim that light itself is electromagnetic was verified along the way. Tellingly, Hertz himself was cool about the practical promise of this epoch-making discovery, reportedly declaring the waves 'of no use whatsoever'. Yet it was this very experiment that opened the age of radio communication: Marconi and Tesla later sent electromagnetic waves into the sky, breeding broadcast, radar, television and today's mobile phones. The unit of frequency was named the hertz in his honour; and the German physicist, honoured by that name, died young in 1894 at just 36, only after which did the 'Hertz electromagnetic-wave experiment' become a phrase forever cited.

term: 阴极射线实验：电子的发现
oneLiner: 汤姆孙测出阴极射线的比荷，发现第一种亚原子粒子。
oneLinerEn: Thomson measured the ray's charge-to-mass ratio and found the first subatomic particle.
detail: 十九世纪末，真空管里从阴极射出的“阴极射线”究竟是波还是粒子，争论不休：赫兹让它穿过薄金窗仍能透出，据此支持波动说；克鲁克斯却发现电场与磁场都能把它打偏。1897 年汤姆孙在卡文迪许实验室用测量代替争论：同时加上电场与磁场，把两种偏折调成互相抵消，先定出射线的速度，再由纯磁场下的偏转半径算出比荷 e/m——约为氢离子荷质比的 1800 倍。无论换阴极金属还是管中气体，这个数值都不变，可见它是所有物质共有的组分，而不是某种原子的离子。电子由此成为第一个被发现的亚原子粒子，汤姆孙把它叫作“微粒”。他测到的是电荷与质量之比，电荷本身还要等密立根油滴实验量出，两值相除才得到电子质量。1906 年他因电子获诺贝尔物理学奖，显像管与电子显微镜都是这一测量的下游。
detailEn: In the 1890s physicists argued over whether the 'cathode ray' streaming from the cathode of an evacuated tube was a wave or a particle. Hertz let it pass a thin gold window and read that as evidence for waves; Crookes saw it bent by both electric and magnetic fields. In 1897 J.J. Thomson settled it at the Cavendish by measuring instead of arguing: he applied electric and magnetic fields together, balanced the two deflections to fix the speed, then used the pure-magnetic deflection radius to get the charge-to-mass ratio - about 1800 times that of the hydrogen ion. Swapping the cathode metal or the gas changed nothing, so this was an ingredient shared by all matter rather than an ion of some atom. The electron became the first subatomic particle ever found, and Thomson called it a 'corpuscle'. He measured a ratio: the charge itself had to wait for Millikan's oil drops, and dividing the two yields the electron mass. Thomson took the 1906 Nobel Prize, and cathode-ray tubes and electron microscopes are downstream of that one measurement.

oneLiner: 电子撞汞原子，每 4.9 伏丢一次能量，能级当场现身。
oneLinerEn: Electrons striking mercury lost energy in 4.9-volt steps, showing levels directly.
detail: 玻尔 1913 年给原子安排了分立能级，可证据全来自光谱线，属于“事后反推”。1914 年弗兰克与赫兹在柏林改用电子直接撞原子：真空管充汞蒸气，电子被加速电压 U 推向栅极，越过栅极后还得克服一小段反向拒斥电压才能到达板极形成电流。按经典图像，电子撞气原子只会连续地一点点损失能量，电流该随 U 一路上扬。实测却在 U 到达 4.9 伏时骤然跌落，此后每隔 4.9 伏重复一次：电子只能整份交出 4.9 电子伏把汞原子送上第一激发态，攒不满这一份就撞不出能量损失，越过栅极的电子依旧能到板极。这是原子内部能量量子化的第一次直接证明，两人因此获 1925 年诺贝尔奖。同一装置换氢气，第一激发能是 10.2 电子伏（13.6 减 3.4）。要点在于“非弹性碰撞也有门槛”，而非电子被原子吞掉。
detailEn: Bohr gave atoms discrete levels in 1913, but the evidence came from spectral lines - reasoning after the fact. In 1914 Franck and Hertz in Berlin bombarded atoms with electrons instead: a tube filled with mercury vapour accelerated electrons toward a grid by a voltage U, and beyond the grid they still had to climb a small reverse retarding voltage to reach the plate and make a current. On the classical picture an electron rubbing past a gas atom would bleed energy continuously, so the current should simply keep rising with U. Instead it collapsed the moment U reached 4.9 volts, then collapsed again every 4.9 volts after that: an electron can only hand over a whole 4.9 electronvolts to lift a mercury atom to its first excited state, and short of that bundle there is no inelastic loss at all, so the electron still arrives. This was the first direct proof of quantised energy inside the atom and won them the 1925 Nobel Prize. Refilled with hydrogen, the same tube shows 10.2 electronvolts (13.6 minus 3.4). The lesson is that inelastic collisions have a threshold, not that atoms swallow electrons.

oneLiner: 镍晶体把电子束衍射出峰，物质波得到实测。
oneLinerEn: A nickel crystal diffracted electrons into sharp peaks, confirming matter waves.
detail: 德布罗意 1924 年猜想电子也该有波长 λ = h/p，可是没人测到过。1925 年戴维孙与革末在贝尔实验室用电子轰镍靶，一次空气漏进真空室、镍面氧化，他们高温退火补救，结果原先的多晶长成了几块大单晶——散射强度随角度出现尖锐的峰，和过去平滑的曲线完全不同。他们没有把这桩事故扫掉，而是当成结果来处理：1927 年用 54 电子伏的电子测出强度极大角，与布拉格条件 2d sinθ = λ、取镍晶面间距 0.091 纳米算出的 0.167 纳米严丝合缝；同年 G. P. 汤姆孙让电子穿过超薄金箔，拍到了衍射环。电子确实会衍射。最妙的一对是：父亲 J. J. 汤姆孙因证明电子是粒子获奖（1906），儿子 G. P. 汤姆孙因证明它是波获奖（1937），父子相隔三十一年各领一次诺贝尔物理学奖。宏观棒球的波长只有 10⁻³⁴ 米量级，波动性永远显不出来。
detailEn: De Broglie guessed in 1924 that electrons should carry a wavelength λ = h/p, but nobody had measured one. In 1925 Davisson and Germer at Bell Labs fired electrons at a nickel target; air leaked into the chamber, the surface oxidised, and their high-temperature anneal turned the polycrystal into a few large single crystals - and the scattering intensity suddenly grew sharp peaks against angle where the curve had been smooth. They treated the accident as a result: in 1927, with 54-electronvolt electrons, the peak angle agreed exactly with the Bragg condition 2d sinθ = λ using a nickel plane spacing of 0.091 nanometres, implying λ = 0.167 nanometres, and that same year G. P. Thomson shot electrons through ultrathin gold foil and photographed the diffraction rings. Electrons really do diffract. The loveliest pairing: the father J. J. Thomson was honoured for proving the electron is a particle (1906), the son G. P. Thomson for proving it is a wave (1937), the two honoured thirty-one years apart for opposite faces of the same particle. A baseball's wavelength is of order 10⁻³⁴ metres, so its wave nature never shows.

oneLiner: α 轰铍放出的中性粒子，撞出质子才露出真身。
oneLinerEn: Beryllium's neutral emission betrayed itself by knocking protons loose.
detail: 用 α 粒子轰击铍，会冒出一束穿透力极强的“辐射”。1930 年博特与贝克尔以为它是 γ 射线；1932 年约里奥-居里夫妇把它照向石蜡，打出的质子快得离谱，反推需要几千万电子伏的光子——能量账本已经对不上，他们仍按 γ 解释，与发现擦肩。查德威克重复实验并加测氢、氦、锂等反冲核，只换一个假设：来的是质量与质子相近、不带电的粒子。碰撞要同时守住动量与能量守恒，一个中性粒子撞飞质子毫不费力，γ 却得强到不合常理才做得到。他定出中子质量略大于质子（今值 1.0087 原子质量单位），沿用卢瑟福 1920 年设想的名称。原子核从此是质子与中子的组合，同位素有了说法；更要紧的是中子不带电、不受核的静电排斥，才成了撬开原子核的探针——费米随即用它轰出一串新核素，裂变也在 1938 年被叩开。自由中子本身并不稳定，约 880 秒就 β 衰变，1935 年查德威克因发现中子得诺贝尔物理学奖。
detailEn: Bombarding beryllium with alpha particles produced a strangely penetrating 'radiation'. Bothe and Becker read it as gamma rays in 1930; in 1932 the Joliot-Curies aimed it at paraffin and found the protons it knocked loose far too fast, implying photons of tens of millions of electronvolts - the energy ledger no longer balanced, yet they kept the gamma interpretation and missed the discovery. Chadwick repeated the experiment, added recoil measurements on hydrogen, helium and lithium, and changed just one assumption: the incoming particle weighs about as much as a proton and carries no charge. Since collisions must obey both momentum and energy, a neutral bullet flips a proton effortlessly while a gamma quantum would need an absurd energy to do the same. He fixed the neutron's mass as slightly above the proton's (today 1.0087 atomic mass units) and kept the name Rutherford had proposed in 1920. Nuclei were now protons plus neutrons, which finally explained isotopes; and because a neutron feels no electric repulsion from the nucleus, it became the probe that pried nuclei open - Fermi used it at once, and fission followed in 1938. A free neutron is unstable, beta-decaying in about 880 seconds, and Chadwick took the 1935 Nobel Prize for the discovery.

oneLiner: 银原子束在非均匀磁场里裂成两条，取向竟是量子化的。
oneLinerEn: A silver beam split in two inside an inhomogeneous field, quantising orientation.
detail: 1922 年在汉堡，斯特恩与革拉赫让一束银原子穿过非均匀磁场——磁极削成楔形，使场强沿束的方向变化，原子磁矩会被往侧面拧。按经典图像，磁矩取向是连续的，底片上该出现一条被拉宽的模糊带。洗出来却是清清楚楚的两条，中间留着一道空白：取向只能取两个分立值，这是空间量子化最干净的演示。更棘手的是银原子基态的轨道角动量为零，按当时的理论一束本不该分裂。直到 1925 年乌伦贝克与古兹密特提出电子自旋，自旋量子数 1/2 对应 2 × 1/2 + 1 = 2 条，分裂间距由玻尔磁子定住，结果才对上号。这套分子射线法后来支撑起光谱精细结构与塞曼反常的解释，也是磁共振与原子钟的远祖；斯特恩因它获 1943 年诺贝尔化学奖。还有一点常被忽略：选中了两个取向之一，其余取向的信息就被抹掉了——这是“测量扰动量子态”最早的实物样板。
detailEn: In Hamburg in 1922 Stern and Gerlach sent a beam of silver atoms through an inhomogeneous magnetic field - pole pieces ground into a wedge so the field strength varied across the beam and twisted each atomic magnet sideways. Classically the orientations are continuous, so the plate should record one smeared band. What developed was two clean lines with a gap between them: orientation takes only discrete values, the cleanest demonstration of space quantisation ever made. The awkward part is that silver's ground state carries zero orbital angular momentum, so on the theory of the day the beam should not have split at all. Not until 1925, when Uhlenbeck and Goudsmit proposed electron spin, did it add up - spin one-half gives 2 × 1/2 + 1 = 2 lines, with the spacing set by the Bohr magneton. The molecular-ray method behind it went on to support fine structure and the anomalous Zeeman effect and is an ancestor of magnetic resonance and atomic clocks; Stern received the 1943 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. One detail is often skipped: picking one of the two orientations erases the information in the others, making this the earliest hardware demonstration that measurement disturbs the quantum state.

term: 阿斯顿质谱仪与同位素实测
oneLiner: 磁场按质量把离子排成谱线，同位素从假设变成读数。
oneLinerEn: A magnetic field lined ions up by mass, turning isotopes from hypothesis into readings.
detail: 索迪 1913 年为化学性质相同、质量不同的原子造了「同位素」一词，把它称出质量的是质谱仪。原理是两段筛选：离子经加速电压 U 得到动能 qU = ½mv²，进入垂直磁场走圆周，半径 r = mv/(qB)；两式一消得 r = √(2mU/(qB²))——同一电荷下质量越大拐得越缓，落在底片不同位置，一条线就是一种核素，线的浓淡就是天然丰度。汤姆孙 1913 年在阳极射线里看到氖的双亮斑只是雏形，阿斯顿 1919 年起把它做成精密仪器，测出二百余种同位素：氖确有其二（²⁰Ne 与 ²²Ne），氯的两兄弟约 3 ∶ 1，于是“35.5”不再是谜，它只是加权平均。各核素质量还都紧贴整数（整数规则，1922 年诺贝尔化学奖），偏离的那一点正是把核子捆在一起的代价：氦-4 比两个质子加两个中子轻约 0.030 原子质量单位。同位素电子结构一样、化学性质几乎相同，分离只靠这点质量差，所以扩散与离心都得反复上百级；碳-14 测年、氧同位素判古温度与铀-235 提纯都出自这台仪器。
detailEn: Soddy coined 'isotope' in 1913 for atoms of identical chemistry but different mass; the instrument that weighed them was the mass spectrograph. Two selections do the work: an ion gains kinetic energy qU = ½mv² from an accelerating voltage, then circles a perpendicular field at radius r = mv/(qB), and eliminating v gives r = √(2mU/(qB²)) - at equal charge the heavier ion bends more lazily and lands elsewhere on the plate, so each line is one nuclide and its darkness is its natural abundance. Thomson's twin bright spots in canal rays (1913) were only a prototype; from 1919 Aston turned the idea into a precision instrument and identified over two hundred isotopes, confirming neon's two forms (²⁰Ne and ²²Ne) and chlorine's pair at roughly 3 to 1, which made '35.5' a plain weighted average. Nuclide masses also hug whole numbers - the packing rule that won the 1922 Nobel Prize in Chemistry - and the shortfall is precisely the price of binding nucleons together: helium-4 comes out about 0.030 atomic mass units lighter than two protons plus two neutrons. Since isotopes share an electron structure and thus nearly identical chemistry, separation exploits only this sliver of mass, which is why diffusion and centrifugation run through a hundred stages; carbon-14 dating, palaeotemperature from oxygen isotopes and uranium-235 purification all come from this one instrument.

oneLiner: 过饱和蒸气替粒子画出径迹，一条弯错方向的雾迹交出第一个反电子。
oneLinerEn: Supersaturated vapor drew particle tracks, and one curling the wrong way handed physics its first positron.
detail: 云室靠一口气工作。威尔逊在 1911 年前后做成这台装置：密闭容器里让酒精或水蒸气处于过饱和，缺了凝核就悬着不动；带电粒子穿过时沿途打出一串离子，液滴立刻在这些离子上凝结，一条雾迹替看不见的粒子画了像。加上磁场，雾迹弯成弧线——弯得急说明动量小，弯的朝向指出电荷正负，迹的浓淡还能反映快慢。1932 年安德森在宇宙线里挑出一条诡异的弧：偏转半径对应的质量与电子同量级，弯曲方向却属于正电。粒子穿过一块 0.6 厘米的铅板后能量变小、弧更急，据此判定它由下往上飞，正电荷不是假象——这是第一个反电子，他起初只叫它“带正电的电子”，1933 年起有了新名 positron。狄拉克 1928 年方程里那条多余的正能量支，1931 年被他自己解成反电子，说它与电子相遇会一同湮灭、放出辐射；从方程到那张照片隔了四年。1933 年布莱克特与奥基亚尼用盖革计数器触发的自动云室拍到成对诞生：一个 γ 光子在核附近整套消失，变成一正一负两条对称雾迹；湮灭则至少交回两个 0.511 MeV 的光子，因为单凭一个光子守不住能量与动量。此事还有先声——赵忠尧 1930 年测硬 γ 射线在铅里的吸收，发现散射辐射比理论强出约四分之一，正是电子对的信号，他当时没有解释，安德森在论文里点名引用了那篇工作。云室此后被格拉塞 1952 年的气泡室接班，威尔逊本人已因这台装置拿了 1927 年诺贝尔奖；要紧的是它第一次让单个基本粒子的径迹成了可以拍照的证据。
detailEn: A cloud chamber runs on a breath of vapor. Wilson built the first practical version around 1911: a sealed box holds alcohol or water vapor supersaturated, hanging there for want of nuclei to condense on. A charged particle plowing through leaves a line of ions along its path, droplets snap out at once, and a streak of fog draws a portrait of something nobody can see. In a magnetic field the streak curls - a tight curl means little momentum, the sense of the curl gives the sign of the charge, and the thickness of the fog hints at speed. In 1932 Anderson picked out a strange curl in the cosmic rays: its radius suited a mass no heavier than an electron, yet it bent the way positive charge bends. The particle had crossed a 0.6 cm lead plate and come out slower, its arc tighter on the far side, so it had traveled upward and the positive sign was no artifact - the first anti-electron, which he at first simply called a positive electron and which took the name positron in 1933. Dirac's 1928 equation had carried a leftover positive-energy branch; in 1931 he read it as an anti-electron that would annihilate with an ordinary electron in a burst of radiation, and four years passed between the equation and the photograph. In 1933 Blackett and Occhialini, triggering the chamber automatically with Geiger counters, photographed pairs being born: a gamma quantum vanishing near a nucleus into two symmetric tracks, while annihilation returned at least two 0.511 MeV photons because one photon alone cannot keep both energy and momentum. There had been a foretone: in 1930 Chao Chung-Yao measured the absorption of hard gamma rays in lead and found the scattered radiation some quarter stronger than theory allowed, which is the signature of pair creation; he did not interpret it, and Anderson cited that 1930 paper by name. Glaser's bubble chamber took over from 1952, and Wilson himself had already shared the 1927 Nobel Prize for the device; what mattered was that the track of a single elementary particle had become a photographable piece of evidence.

term: 吴健雄的宇称不守恒实验
oneLiner: 把钴-60 冻到近乎绝对零度并排好自旋，β 电子飞得左右不均——镜像里的物理并不相同。
oneLinerEn: Cooled cobalt-60 with aligned spins threw beta electrons unevenly - the physics in the mirror is not the same.
detail: 宇称就是镜像对称：物理规律在镜子里是否照样成立。1956 年以前它被当作不言自明的守恒律，与能量、动量守恒同排写进规则表，原子光谱的跃迁选择定则与核能级的奇偶分类都靠它撑腰。裂缝出在两种介子上：τ 与 θ 的质量、电荷、寿命一模一样，τ 却衰变成两个 π、θ 衰变成三个，而两 π 的宇称为正、三 π 为负——若宇称守恒，它们必是两种粒子，可它们实在像到无从区分。李政道与杨振宁把已有实验从头翻了一遍，摸到一个关键事实：强作用与电磁作用里宇称确有检验，弱作用里一次都没测过。他们列出十来条可做的判据。吴健雄挑了钴-60。样品用绝热去磁冻到百分之几开尔文，低温设备由美国标准局的团队主持；加上强磁场把钴核自旋排向一边，再在自旋方向与其反方向各摆一台闪烁计数器数 β 电子。温度高、自旋混乱时两臂计数相同；一排序两臂立刻分开；把磁场翻转、自旋反向，不对称也跟着翻转——仪器偏见被排除在外，偏心来自自然本身。结果 1957 年初发表：核自旋指向某一边时，β 电子明显更朝自旋的反方向飞出，弱作用只偏爱一只手势，宇称不守恒。物理界震动，李、杨当年即获诺贝尔物理学奖，而做出决定性实验的吴健雄不在获奖名单上，她 1978 年领得首届沃尔夫物理奖。此后一年里中微子被确认只有左旋，β 衰变的耦合写成 V−A 形式；1964 年中性 K 介子又显示，连电荷共轭与宇称联合起来的 CP 也有一点点破缺。镜像两侧不全同，不是规律出了错，而是自然本就偏用一只手。
detailEn: Parity is mirror symmetry: whether the laws of physics hold the same way in a mirror. Before 1956 it was booked as a self-evident conservation law, written down next to energy and momentum, and the selection rules of atomic spectra plus the even-odd classification of nuclear levels leaned on it. The crack came from two mesons: tau and theta matched in mass, charge and lifetime, yet tau decayed into two pions and theta into three, and two pions carry positive parity while three carry negative - if parity were saved they had to be different particles, however indistinguishable they otherwise looked. Lee and Yang went through the existing experiments and found the decisive gap: parity had been tested in strong and electromagnetic processes but never once in a weak one, and they listed about a dozen ways to try. Wu chose cobalt-60. Her sample was chilled to a few hundredths of a kelvin by adiabatic demagnetization in a cryostat run by the team at the US National Bureau of Standards; a strong field lined the cobalt nuclear spins up on one side, and scintillation counters set along and against that direction counted the beta electrons. Warm and disoriented, the two arms agreed; align the spins and the counts split at once; reverse the field, reversing the spins, and the asymmetry flipped with it - instrumental bias was ruled out and the handedness belonged to nature. The result appeared in early 1957: with the nuclear spins pointing one way the beta electrons came out preferentially the other way, and parity is not conserved. Physics reeled; Lee and Yang took the Nobel Prize in Physics that same year while Wu, whose experiment settled it, was left off the certificate - she received the first Wolf Prize in Physics in 1978. Within a year neutrinos were confirmed to be left-handed only and the coupling of beta decay was written as V - A; in 1964 the neutral kaon showed that even CP, charge conjugation combined with parity, is slightly broken. A world that is not its own mirror image is not a law gone wrong - it is nature preferring one hand.

oneLiner: 铯原子的节拍接管了“一秒”，搬上客机环球飞行又量出了相对论的时间差。
oneLinerEn: The cesium atom's beat took over the second, and flown around the world it measured relativity's time difference.
detail: 钟的历史就是找更稳的周期。普通石英钟一天差一秒上下，天文时靠地球自转，而自转本身被潮汐摩擦与季节变化拽得忽快忽慢。1949 年莱昂斯的氨分子钟只是原理演示，1955 年埃森与帕里在英国国家物理实验室做出第一台可用的铯原子钟：铯-133 原子基态两个超精细能级之间的跃变只认一个微波频率，拿它锁住振荡器，钟就有了原子的节拍。1967 年国际计量大会把一秒定义为该频率走完 9,192,631,770 个周期，从此秒不再依赖地球；今天的铯喷泉钟约几亿年才差一秒，光钟的不确定度还低两个量级，重新定义秒已排上议程。原子钟同时也是相对论的探针。1971 年哈菲勒与基廷把四台铯束原子钟搬上民航客机，分别向东、向西绕地球一圈，落地后与美国海军天文台的基准钟比对。两项效应符号相反：飞得快让钟走慢，飞得高、所在处引力势更高又让钟走快，而地球自转使东向相对地心的速度大于西向，两条航线的净差因此一负一正。实测东向慢约 59 纳秒、西向快约 275 纳秒，与相对论算出的 −40 ± 23 和 +272 ± 21 在不确定度内相符。同样的修正在导航卫星上是日常事务：GPS 卫星在约两万公里高的轨道上，引力项每天快约 45 微秒、速度项每天慢约 7 微秒，净快 38 微秒，出厂时就得先把频率偏掉；若不校正，定位误差每天累积十来公里。北斗与其他系统做的是同一道算术。
detailEn: The history of clocks is a hunt for a steadier period. An ordinary quartz clock strays about a second a day, and astronomical time rested on Earth's rotation, which tidal friction and the seasons tug in and out of regularity. Lyons demonstrated an ammonia atomic clock in 1949 but it was only a proof of principle; in 1955 Essen and Parry at the National Physical Laboratory built the first usable cesium clock. The two hyperfine levels of the cesium-133 ground state differ by one exact microwave frequency, so locking an oscillator to that transition gave time an atomic beat. In 1967 the General Conference on Weights and Measures defined the second as 9,192,631,770 cycles of that radiation, and timekeeping stopped depending on the Earth; cesium fountains now lose a second in hundreds of millions of years, optical clocks run two orders of magnitude better, and redefining the second is already on the agenda. Atomic clocks also make relativity measurable. In 1971 Hafele and Keating carried four cesium-beam clocks aboard airliners around the world, eastbound and westbound, and compared them afterward with the reference clocks at the US Naval Observatory. Two effects pull opposite ways: moving fast runs a clock slow, while climbing into the higher gravitational potential aloft runs it fast, and because the Earth's rotation makes the eastbound speed through space larger than the westbound one, the net difference comes out negative on one route and positive on the other. The measured figures were roughly -59 and +275 nanoseconds against relativity's -40 ± 23 and +272 ± 21 - agreement within the uncertainty. The same corrections are routine for navigation satellites: a GPS clock in an orbit about twenty thousand kilometers high gains some 45 microseconds a day from gravity and loses some 7 from its orbital speed, a net 38 microseconds that must be trimmed out of the oscillator before launch, or positions would drift by some ten kilometers every day. BeiDou and the other systems do the same arithmetic.
